title: acokanthera oblongifolia
intro: Acokanthera oblongifolia, commonly known as Peter's rose or Leopard's bane, is a succulent plant native to the tropical regions of East Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and snake bites, due to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of Acokanthera oblongifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including glycosides, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antispasmodic and anti-arrhythmic activities. Additionally, research has identified the presence of bufadienolides, a class of cardiac glycosides, as the primary bioactive constituents responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
